name: Rook
situation: Locksmith in the Merchants' Quarter. Has been giving the Syndicate access to merchant vaults for two years under a 'maintenance contract' — he marks the locks, they enter at will, he receives protection for his workshop. He tells himself it is just work.
want: Reduce his exposure — the Syndicate has escalated from occasional vault access to demanding he install permanent bypass mechanisms in twelve locks by the end of the month. He wants to slow this down without appearing to refuse.
stake: His apprentice Ilya is fifteen. Rook took him in after the Syndicate took Ilya's parents two years ago — around the same time Rook's cooperation began. Ilya does not know this. If Rook's arrangement is exposed, Ilya will be seen as the son of informants raised by their handler. The resistance will not distinguish between what Ilya knew and what Rook did.
network: Holds access maps and bypass keys for most high-value locks in the Merchants' Quarter. Makes regular service calls to the Syndicate district supervisor's office under the guise of maintenance. Overhears merchant conversations during service visits — traders speak freely around the locksmith.
